_metadata.see_also: docs/decision_rationale.md holds the rationale, evidence levels, confidence-gate description, and per-decision prose this file omits.

stage_schema_requirements.description: Schema that every planned_stages entry must satisfy. The Critic enforces this in step 3 for reasoned plans; make_deterministic_plan.py satisfies it automatically via the STAGE_TRACK dict.

uncertainty_reduction_probes.description: Optional cheap experiments a reasoned plan may schedule BEFORE the full pipeline to reduce the dominant uncertainty. Each maps to an existing or planned ROADMAP capability.

fast_density_screen.mechanism: small-cell short NPT; compare density to experimental within +/-10%; max 2 FF retries (ROADMAP E3, currently BLOCKED on A1/A2 — record as planned, not executed, until unblocked).

literature_anchor.mechanism: search_ff_literature(smiles, name) -> reference FF + density/Tg targets + DOI (ROADMAP E2).

hardware_benchmark.reduces: hardware_optimum — the mpi/gpu config uncertainty for an off-table FF, an unusually sized cell, or a host whose hardware_policy is not cleanly benchmarked (values_are_benchmarked=false or host mismatch)
hardware_benchmark.mechanism: hardware/calibrate_hardware.py (wrapping hardware/benchmark_hardware.py) sweeps the mpi/gpu matrix on the built .data per template cost class, reports ns/day + Pair/Kspace/Neigh/Comm breakdown, names the winner, and writes directional_probe + by_forcefield (the latter only on a clean uncontended sweep). Runs politely around live runs (idle GPU + spare cores only, niced, sequential).

hardware.default_source: polymer_rules.json:hardware_policy.by_forcefield.<FF_FAMILY> (the only priced config per family today — recommended_by_ff/size_points describe its own measured throughput, not an alternative to switch to)

system_size.default_source: DERIVED per-SMILES by select_system_size.derive_cell -- polymer_rules.json:classes.<CLASS>.{dp_typical,nchain,dp_min} were all REMOVED 2026-09-02. Only density_initial_gcm3 still comes from the class. DP = ceil(SYSTEM_MW_FLOOR_GMOL / (MIN_NCHAIN * M_repeat)), i.e. 50,000 g/mol of total system mass at nchain=10 (Wang 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41428-020-00443-1).

equilibration.default_source: tool:check_equilibration_comprehensive (twice: once on the melt hold, once on the assessment cell) + tool:assess_cooling_contraction (density-value routing, cooling stage only)

gates.description: D-05 adjudicates two cells now. The melt gate runs at the end of the equilibration stage on npt_melt_hold; the assessment gate runs at the end of the cooling stage on npt_final. One decision id, two verdicts (equil_verdict, cool_verdict); the run summary reports the cooling verdict when the cooling stage ran, else the melt verdict.
gates.require_melt_rationale: A melt is the one state in which chain relaxation is physically attainable on MD timescales, so rg (chain-dimension equilibration) and ct (end-to-end decorrelation) BIND here -- they are advisory at the assessment temperature only because a glass cannot satisfy them, not because they do not matter. ct is skipped where the class carries ct_gate_reliable=false, the same carve-out require_glassy already applies. msd_not_trapped, msid_gaussian and residual_stress stay advisory everywhere (enforce_gate.ALWAYS_ADVISORY).
